svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 2,100 long, square; file the burr off both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark one face as the canal side. 1,150 up from the bottom end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (250 above ground when set), on the face centre line:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: canal-side wall: drill 17.5 for the M16 bolt;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back wall, same axis: drill 21.5 for the crush tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Use a drill guide or drill press so both holes share one axis.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr; cold galvanising paint on the holes and cut ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark a ground line 900 up from the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: 900 sits in the footing, 100 above its base;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate and box on the canal face; cap on top.
